title: Alloy-XRD-Bench: HEA-SRO and Gamma-Decomp
description:
Alloy-XRD-Bench is a first-stage benchmark toward alloy powder-XRD refinement, with complementary HEA-SRO and Gamma-Decomp subproblems and separate evaluation metrics.

Version 1.1.2 corrects SRO zero-count labels and masks, updates evaluation code, and provides the revised manuscript and corrected-result summaries. The source-bound label overlay covers 88,019 states; frozen original split membership is retained. The versioned dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jimi7771/alloy-xrd-bench/tree/v1.1.2.

This correction does not claim a completed joint refinement pipeline or completion of the outstanding Gamma, traditional-baseline, finite-size, and experimental-validation work. See the release notes for scope and limitations. Reviewer reports and response letters are excluded.

This work was financially supported by the Advanced Materials-National Science and Technology Major Project (Grant No. 2025ZD0620100), National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant No. 52401015), and Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Open Source Award Project.
